Non-MSPs and single-market onsite out-of-state shops are excluded. UNVERIFIED first-pass capture from public marketplace summaries — confirm every figure against the CIM. listings.headline: High-Margin, Customized IT Services Business (150 clients, 7 states)
listings.description: customized IT services and support for SMB and enterprise, referral-driven
listings.statusNote: Cannot confirm active. Every search hit repeats identical 2023 revenue / 2024-pace figures (a ~2024 snapshot), the tagged county page is empty, all deep-links are dead/blocked, and it's not findable in live search — consistent with SOLD or WITHDRAWN and stale search caching. Verify with the broker before spending any time.
listings.notes: Established 2007; 150 clients across 7 states (multi-state = remote-delivering, operable from Dallas regardless of HQ). Team ~7: 6 full-time + 1 part-time + a CONTRACTOR acting as operations manager, plus a lead support specialist with 17 yrs tenure. 2023 rev ~$3.2M / adj EBITDA ~$1.7M (~53% margin — very high for an MSP; QoE/add-backs are the first diligence item), 2024 pace ~$1.86M. Price gated. RISKS: contractor 'GM' (transferability), key-person concentration on the 17-yr tech, lean staffing may be under-investment. Above the Deal-1 SBA sweet spot on size. DATA-QUALITY WARNING: the financials are consistent across platforms but the LOCATION metadata conflicts (BizQuest=Brazos County, but that county's page is empty; Transworld files it under DFW Central) and every deep-link is bot-blocked/unstable — treat location as unconfirmed. If it's genuinely DFW, that's home turf (a plus); confirm with the broker. RELIABLE PATH: Transworld Business Advisors, DFW Central office — ask for 'High-Margin, Customized IT Services Business' (aggregator id 2304615 / BW2304615; earlier ref cited 76931-872431).

Financials + location CONFIDENTIAL/gated. Need numbers before it can be tiered properly.

listings.headline: Mid-Atlantic Technology Services Platform (MSSP / cloud / IT)
listings.description: managed services, cybersecurity, managed security MSSP, cloud, IT consulting, procurement, licensing, staff augmentation
listings.notes: OUT-OF-STATE (Mid-Atlantic). 75-100 customers across commercial, healthcare, GOVERNMENT, LEGAL, manufacturing, tech; 98% of revenue from existing relationships (very sticky). Legal/government exposure = professional-services vertical fit. CAVEATS: broad service mix (procurement, licensing, staff augmentation) dilutes MRR quality; 'Mid-Atlantic region' implies some onsite delivery — verify how remote-operable it is from Dallas. Size/price gated. A platform-scale lead worth a CIM.
